DEVS.doc: Known chimera divergences from AWS S3, per cell.

known.delete-object-200: AWS DeleteObject answers 204 No Content for a key it removed (S3 API Reference, DeleteObject); chimera answers 200 OK.
known.delete-object-missing-404: AWS DeleteObject is idempotent -- 204 for a key that was never there; chimera answers 404 NoSuchKey.
known.delete-bucket-nonempty-500: AWS DeleteBucket answers 409 BucketNotEmpty; chimera maps BUCKET_NOT_EMPTY through its default 500 InternalError.
known.copy-self-200: AWS rejects a CopyObject of an object onto itself with no metadata directive: 400 InvalidRequest; chimera performs it and answers 200.
known.range-full-200: AWS answers 206 for every satisfiable Range including one covering the whole object (RFC 7233 4.1); chimera collapses a whole-object range to 200.
